test_files.target_module: src/health/gate.ts, src/health/run.ts, and health source outcome aggregation

tests.description: required missing, skipped, disabled, and failed checks produce incomplete while an optional skip remains visible without making coverage incomplete
tests.criterion: Required coverage and finding outcomes are independent; optional skips remain truthful

tests.description: a P0 finding produces fail while the gate still records incomplete required coverage
tests.criterion: Confirmed blocking findings dominate without hiding incomplete coverage

tests.description: selecting only complexity records omitted required eslint/typescript checks and cannot report a clean gate
tests.criterion: Source-filter scope reports actual required coverage truthfully

tests.description: a local fake Bun audit returning malformed text with exit zero yields no findings and an incomplete parse instead of PASS
tests.criterion: Unknown or malformed output cannot report clean even with rc0

tests.description: a local fake Bun audit returning one recognized critical advisory with exit one retains that finding and produces FAIL with complete coverage
tests.criterion: Recognized nonzero audit results retain findings and remain distinct from execution/parse failure

tests.description: synthetic Bun package-keyed arrays plus npm modern vulnerabilities and legacy advisories preserve deterministic unique advisory identity and mapped severity
tests.criterion: Supported Bun and npm audit formats parse deterministically from public synthetic fixtures

tests.description: the stored-report service returns exit code one for an incomplete gate even when strict-warn is absent
tests.criterion: Strict service gate behavior accepts only PASS

tests.description: health run --strict --source eslint prints an incomplete report and sets exit code one when required eslint is skipped
tests.criterion: Strict CLI rejects incomplete and exposes the selected source status

additional_green_commands: bun test src/health/gate.test.ts src/health/parsers.test.ts src/health/service-status.test.ts src/commands/health-status.test.ts
notes: All runtime audit cases use a temporary local node_modules/.bin/bun script with synthetic public JSON or malformed text; no package registry, network, provider, model, credential, or private audit data is accessed. The fixtures exercise the existing runHealth -> runAdapter -> dependencyAuditAdapter boundary, so no test-only production seam is required. Tests intentionally assert externally visible report/gate/source behavior rather than a private helper layout. Existing health assertions were left unchanged. commit_test_stubs=false; no git or flow state was mutated.
